cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three more departments for me! Remember when I taught you to manage one? Look how far your teacher's reach extends now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Clever—you remembered my advice about being visible. I'll have a presence everywhere.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! You're finally thinking on my scale. Put my name above all three departments on the label. Large lettering—you always made my name so hard to find.

reason: Replace the explanatory territory metaphor with a specific label layout and backhanded reminder that performs the claimed enlarged influence.
